sentences.en: He shared his box of biscuits with all his friends.
sentences.zh: 他把饼干盒分给了所有朋友。

sentences.en: We shared the money evenly amongst the three of us.
sentences.zh: 我们三人平分了这笔钱。

sentences.en: Lisa's preference for classical music was not shared by Mark.
sentences.zh: 莉萨喜欢古典音乐的喜好并没有得到马克的认可。

senses.zh: 共享的;共同的v.共享;分享;“share”的过去式和过去分词
